name: wiki-drift
about: The wiki-drift task on a small tool in Python, not .NET. Two pages, four discrepancies seeded (timeout 60 vs 30, $APP_HOME vs SYNC_HOME, --verbose vs --debug, batch default 1000 vs 500) beside four claims that are right. The truth is that all four are found; how many were found is the scenario's coverage.
request: Сверь утверждения в Docs/wiki/ с кодом в app/. Работай по одной странице: прочитай страницу, найди в коде то, на что она ссылается, и запиши расхождения в Docs/DRIFT.md.

checks.about: A check of the wiki against the code changes neither.
